other_conditions: The child must be without biological or adoptive parents, or have lost both parents, or have lost a single bread‑earning parent, or be residing in a Child Care Institution, under foster care, or under the care of a guardian or any fit person/surviving parent.
The student must be pursuing higher education (minimum one‑year after Class‑12) in any government or non‑government college or university.
benefits_summary: All education‑related fees are exempted and eligible students receive free accommodation and food.
documents_required: Certificate issued by the District Child Protection Officer (DCPO)
Recommendation letter from the Child Welfare Committee (CWC)
Specially Cared Child Certificate / I‑Card (for children of COVID‑19 victims)
Annexure‑I: Application for availing benefits under Green Passage Scheme
Annexure‑II: Recommendation by Child Welfare Committee
Annexure‑III: Certificate to avail benefits under Green Passage Scheme
